registration_scope: Scoped analysis protocol documented after initial exploratory seeds began; reported descriptively rather than as prospective preregistration
initialization: Shared 2-relation parameter state copied into 3-relation spatial model with post-init RNG state restored
training_inputs: Spot scanpy Z (ddof=1), gene Z (ddof=0), deterministic Top-Z K=20, normalized X KL target, spatial median bisection tile plus one-hop halo
clustering: Frozen warm-up representation clustered via Leiden target-K=5 resolution sweep 0.10..3.00 step 0.05 without label feedback
primary_endpoint: rare binary F1 at truth <=5%, predicted cluster <=5%

null_tests.coordinate_permutation: Inference-time full-graph evaluation after spot-coordinate permutation
null_tests.degree_rewire: Inference-time full-graph evaluation after degree-preserving double-edge swaps (no self-loops)
null_tests.message_block_holdout: Paired run with spatial edges touching leftmost 20% x-coordinate spots withheld during training

success_gate.paired_primary: All three paired rare-F1 differences > 0 with mean exceeding sample SD, exceeding reversible relation-off ablation
success_gate.on_failure: Record absence of consistent spatial benefit under the evaluated configuration
